name: unsafe fn drop (slot : & mut ManuallyDrop < T >)
rule: While `ManuallyDrop::drop(slot)` is executing, parts of the contained value may be accessed only through the `&mut self` references supplied to the `Drop::drop` methods it invokes.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::mem::manually_drop::ManuallyDrop < T > { unsafe fn drop (slot : & mut core::mem::manually_drop::ManuallyDrop < T >) }
expression: The supplied DSL cannot express this requirement: it has no observations for accesses during execution or for the identities of references supplied to invoked `Drop::drop` methods.
